BackstoryDef.title: herdstone born
BackstoryDef.description: Child of the herdstone, [PAWN_nameDef] was somehow concieved through the warp and had to get by in an unforgivable place.

BackstoryDef.title: herd runt
BackstoryDef.description: Smallest of the litter, [PAWN_nameDef] was kicked away from every kill. [PAWN_pronoun] learned to take food in the dark and to mend the gear the big ones broke.

BackstoryDef.title: hound whelp
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was whelped among the herd's war-hounds and fed from the same carcasses. [PAWN_pronoun] understood snarling long before [PAWN_pronoun] understood speech.

BackstoryDef.title: stone dragger
BackstoryDef.description: Before [PAWN_pronoun] was tall enough to hold a blade, [PAWN_nameDef] hauled tribute rock to the herdstone until [PAWN_possessive] shoulders were raw. The stone hums louder when you stand close to it.

BackstoryDef.title: brayer whelp
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent [PAWN_possessive] youth bellowing the herd's chants at the stone until [PAWN_possessive] throat bled. The shamans taught that the warp listens to the loudest.

BackstoryDef.title: carcass picker
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up on whatever the warherd left behind, boiling marrow from bones the adults had already cracked open.

BackstoryDef.title: herdstone beastman
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] mature quickly in the warp, learning how to slaughter and nothing else.

BackstoryDef.title: herd raider
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] ran with the warherd whenever it came down off the high ground, burning steadings and carrying off anything that bled or bellowed.

BackstoryDef.title: braying shaman
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] tended the herdstone, stacking skulls upon it and braying until the air went thin. The herd feared [PAWN_objective] more than it feared any chieftain.

BackstoryDef.title: beastherd
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] drove the herd's beasts - hounds, gnawers, and worse things that followed the stone's shadow - and kept them hungry enough to stay useful.

BackstoryDef.title: herd champion
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] won the right to stand nearest the stone the only way that right is ever won, then won it again every time something bigger stepped forward.

BackstoryDef.title: wreck breaker
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] broke open hulls and caravan wrecks for the herd, beating the salvage into blades that held an edge better than anything the shamans blessed.

BackstoryDef.title: herdless
BackstoryDef.description: Driven off by a bigger rival, [PAWN_nameDef] spent years beyond the braying, far enough from any herdstone to hear [PAWN_possessive] own thoughts. [PAWN_pronoun] has not forgiven the herd for it.
